title: mananthes cardiophylla
intro: Mananthes cardiophylla, commonly known as the Red Allamanda, is a flowering plant species native to Southeast Asia. This plant is rich in medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Mananthes cardiophylla include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help to reduce fever, relieve pain, and protect against infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant include sedative, antispasmodic, and expectorant effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides.
